item.title: Agricultural Prices
item.description: July Prices Received Index down 4.1 percent from June. The corn price, at $4.26 per bushel, is down 2 cents from last month. The July price for all wheat, at $6.06 per bushel, is 36 cents higher than June. The soybean price, at $11.60 per bushel, is 30 cents higher than June.
